courses.title: Academic Reading and Writing
courses.description: This course integrates the reading and writing skills necessary for success in English reading and writing. Course emphasis will include evaluation, analysis, synthesis, and critical inquiry of assigned readings and essays. Concurrent immersion in this course, specific to the reading and writing process, provides foundational strategies and skills in a transfer-level curriculum.

metadata.Student Learning Outcomes: Demonstrate post-secondary reading and writing processes through metacognitive awareness as illustrated in students' most accomplished assignments. Analyze culturally diverse texts fostering literacy and writing composition skills that illustrate the importance of equitable access for systemically and disproportionately excluded communities.

metadata.Faculty Requirements: Discipline 1 [English] Discipline 2 [Reading] Discipline 3 [ESL] FSA [FHDA FSA - ENGLISH]
metadata.Course Philosophy: Integrated reading and writing is the most successful way for students to improve their collegiate reading and writing skills; this course will be fully integrated and connected to the ENGL C1000 or ENGL C1000H curriculum. It will also emphasize metacognitive awareness, reflection, revision, and the reading and writing processes. An emphasis on a culturally responsive curriculum will be the cornerstone of the class.
metadata.Basic Skill Status (CB08): Course is a basic skills course.
